respuesta.pregunta: In which versions of vendor-stockkeeper-api is the pre-action check of the Operation Id for the feed flow documented? I want to know where that verification step shows up before I touch any inventory flow.
respuesta.respuesta:
All four versions returned for vendor-stockkeeper-api document this step: 0.0.3-paused-seller, 0.0.6-ep-restock-man, 0.0.10-stock-consumer and latest. The wording is the same in each one.

In every version, the step appears in the "Verification Procedure" section of guide/important.md as step 2, "Check the Operation Id (Feed flow)", which says to confirm that the operationId contains all the required items:
- 0.0.3-paused-seller [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.3-paused-seller/guide/important.md:L25-L25]
- 0.0.6-ep-restock-man [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.6-ep-restock-man/guide/important.md:L25-L25]
- 0.0.10-stock-consumer [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.10-stock-consumer/guide/important.md:L25-L25]
- latest [vendor-stockkeeper-api/latest/guide/important.md:L25-L25]

The other two steps are also the same in all four versions. Step 1 is to review the inbound for the restock flow and make sure all test items are present. Step 3 is a final validation of both flows before you take any action [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.3-paused-seller/guide/important.md:L22-L26] [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.6-ep-restock-man/guide/important.md:L22-L26] [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.10-stock-consumer/guide/important.md:L22-L26] [vendor-stockkeeper-api/latest/guide/important.md:L22-L26].
